record.label: Covariance-resummed sparse base under TT16
record.summary: A strong-bond Gaussian path/forest base is mathematically distinct and PSD-valid, but this current production form is closed. A degree-3 path node already costs about 12,441 operations, the optimistic TT16 carrier costs 61,440 per query, and no source-domain remainder theorem exists. Receipt SHA-256 41cecf538bee6a3feadcea88c8d82c35ed4489756bc500084118d11b7b16f561.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed under the current TT16 circuit; preserve only the separate CRX0 common-base theorem and differently fused carrier route.
